entities.summary: Jayanta Kumar Roy is an Indian politician. He has been elected to the Lok Sabha, lower house of the Parliament of India from Jalpaiguri, West Bengal in the 2019 Indian general election and 2024 Indian general election as a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party.
